title: Chapter 484 Three-Party Decisive Battle
content:
Chapter 484 Three-Party Decisive Battle

Wang Shuo glared at Ayub.

Ayub understood, and immediately waved his long sword and ordered: "Attack."

Li Jianguo's crossbow battalion immediately took action.

Bullets were thrown at the opponent's city wall like a flood.

A day later, the city was broken and the emperor was captured.

Wang Shuo no longer paid attention to this prisoner.

After taking over the entire territory of Badandia, Wang Shuo began to pay close attention to the war between the Maka Empire and the Mininia Empire.

At this time, the two of them were in a difficult situation.

There was a faint trend of a truce.

This was not the situation Wang Shuo wanted.

Although Wang Shuo was the only one now, it was still difficult for Wang Shuo to resist the combination of their two empires.

If they fought on two fronts at the same time, the Wana Empire might not be sure of winning.

A month later, Wang Shuo finally got the news that the two empires had signed a peace treaty.

Wang Shuo was a little unhappy, but there was no better way.

It seemed that he could only accumulate strength and look for new opportunities.

It took a year for the Vana Empire to consolidate its current territory and rectify its army. The number of the strongest kings has reached nearly 50.

Wang Shuo felt that he now had the strength to unify the Shenwu Empire.

The Maka Empire is located in the north, and it takes nearly a year to fight from north to south.

The Mininia Empire is located in the east, and Wang Shuo can completely crush it with absolute strength.

So, the war against Mininia was launched again.

The Maka Empire was caught in a very difficult choice.

At this time, should we rescue Mininia?

If we don’t rescue, the next one to perish will definitely be ourselves.

But if we rescue, how to rescue is a problem.

If we unite and destroy the Vana Empire, Mininia will turn around and fight with us.

In the end, they decided to send half of the strongest kings of the empire directly to the Mininia Empire to cooperate with the Mininia army to resist the frontal attack of the Vana Empire.

On the other hand, they marched southward from the north, attacking the territory of the former Badandiya Empire and heading towards the capital of the Vana Empire.

After Guliji detected this news, she immediately reported it to Wang Shuo.

At the military meeting, after discussion, everyone decided to trade depth for time.

As long as they could destroy the opponent's top masters and troops.

Then no matter how much territory the opponent occupied, it could be easily recovered.

Half a year later, the army of the Vana Empire had already arrived at the capital of the Mininia Empire.

And the Maka Empire had also occupied most of the territory of the former Badandiya Empire.

But at this time, they changed their strategy.

The Maka Empire also quickly transferred its main force to the capital of the Mininia Empire.

The main forces of the three parties gathered here.

A decisive battle to determine the ownership of the continent is about to begin.

At this time, the three parties dared not act rashly.

Because if they were not careful, they might be doomed.

The army of the Vana Empire was more than 40 million, and the Maka Empire was more than 30 million.

And there are still 15 million in Mininia.

Although the Vana Empire has an advantage in numbers, most of them are vassal troops, and their combat effectiveness is not good at all.

At this time, the Maka Empire is the strongest side.

Wang Shuo proposed that the strongest kings of the three parties fight to decide the direction of the war.

But this proposal was rejected by the other two empires.

In this way, the three armies were deadlocked here.

Although no large-scale war broke out, small-scale wars still occurred frequently.

The three parties are doing their best to squeeze the potential for war.

Wang Shuo decided to send half of the generals, led by the strongest king, to constantly attack and harass the opponent's supply troops around this battlefield.

This move made the Maka Empire miserable.

In terms of the number of kings, their two countries are far from enough.

The contest between the three parties has changed from a direct confrontation between large armies to a small-scale confrontation between masters.

After the death of two of the strongest kings, the Maka Empire, which could no longer bear it, decided to take the initiative to launch an attack.
